problem:
Problem description
- There is a depot indexed by $$0$$ and a set of customers indexed by $$i \in \mathcal{C}=\{1,2,\ldots,N\}$$.
- A fleet of vehicles is available, indexed by $$k \in \mathcal{V}=\{1,2,\ldots,K\}$$, where only up to $$K$$ vehicles may be used.
- Each location $$i \in \{0\} \cup \mathcal{C}$$ has a position $$\mathbf{p}_i=(x_i,y_i)$$ in the service area.
- Each customer $$i \in \mathcal{C}$$ has a delivery demand $$d_i$$, a hard service time window $$[a_i,b_i]$$, and a service duration $$s_i$$.
- The depot has its own operating time window $$[a_0,b_0]$$.
- Each vehicle has a capacity limit $$Q$$, and the total demand served on any single route must not exceed that capacity.
- Travel between any two locations is described by a distance matrix $$C=[c_{ij}]$$ and, if needed, a travel-time matrix $$T=[\tau_{ij}]$$ for all $$i,j \in \{0\} \cup \mathcal{C}$$.
- The planning horizon is the depot operating horizon $$[a_0,b_0]$$, and all route activity must remain feasible within this horizon.
- The objective is to minimize the total distance traveled by all used vehicles while satisfying all customer demands.

- The required business constraints are:
  - Every customer must be served exactly once by exactly one vehicle.
  - Every used vehicle must start from the depot and return to the depot.
  - Vehicle routes must be continuous and ordered so that service follows the travel sequence.
  - The load carried by any vehicle on its route must never exceed $$Q$$.
  - Service at each customer must begin within that customer’s hard time window $$[a_i,b_i]$$.
  - Early arrival at a customer is allowed only if the vehicle waits until the window opens.
  - Late service start at a customer is not allowed.
  - The service duration at each customer is fixed at $$s_i$$.
  - The depot departure and return times must be consistent with the depot operating window $$[a_0,b_0]$$.
  - The routing plan should minimize the total travel distance, and any secondary operational preferences are not part of the core model unless explicitly provided.

- A solution is represented by:
  - A binary route-selection variable $$u_k$$ indicating whether vehicle $$k$$ is used.
  - A binary arc variable $$x_{ij}^k$$ indicating whether vehicle $$k$$ directly travels from location $$i$$ to location $$j$$.
  - A service-start-time variable $$t_i^k$$ indicating the time vehicle $$k$$ begins service at customer $$i$$ when assigned.
  - A waiting-time variable $$w_i^k$$ indicating any waiting before service begins at customer $$i$$.
  - A route-load variable $$\ell_k$$ indicating the total demand carried by vehicle $$k$$.
  - A route-sequence representation for each used vehicle, listing the ordered customers visited between depot departure and depot return.
  - A total-distance value summarizing the sum of all traveled route distances.

Input Format
{
  "sets": {
    "depot_index": "$$0$$",
    "customer_set": "Customers indexed by $$i \\in \\mathcal{C}=\\{1,2,\\ldots,N\\}$$",
    "vehicle_set": "Vehicles indexed by $$k \\in \\mathcal{V}=\\{1,2,\\ldots,K\\}$$"
  },
  "parameters": {
    "N": "number of customers",
    "K": "maximum number of available vehicles",
    "Q": "vehicle capacity",
    "a_0": "depot opening time",
    "b_0": "depot closing time",
    "p_i": "location of node $$i$$ as $$\\mathbf{p}_i=(x_i,y_i)$$ for all $$i \\in \\{0\\} \\cup \\mathcal{C}$$",
    "d_i": "customer demand for all $$i \\in \\mathcal{C}$$",
    "a_i": "earliest service start time for customer $$i$$",
    "b_i": "latest service start time for customer $$i$$",
    "s_i": "service duration for customer $$i$$",
    "c_ij": "travel distance from node $$i$$ to node $$j$$ for all $$i,j \\in \\{0\\} \\cup \\mathcal{C}$$",
    "tau_ij": "travel time from node $$i$$ to node $$j$$ for all $$i,j \\in \\{0\\} \\cup \\mathcal{C}$$, if used"
  },
  "optional": {
    "distance_definition": "If a distance matrix is not provided, it may be derived from coordinates $$\\mathbf{p}_i$$.",
    "travel_time_definition": "If travel times are not separately provided, they may be assumed proportional to distances."
  }
}

Output Format
{
  "objective_value": "minimum total distance traveled by all used vehicles",
  "vehicles_used": "integer count in $$\\{0,1,\\ldots,K\\}$$",
  "routes": [
    {
      "vehicle_id": "$$k \\in \\mathcal{V}$$",
      "is_used": "$$u_k$$",
      "sequence": "ordered list of visited nodes beginning at $$0$$ and ending at $$0$$",
      "arrival_times": "ordered list of arrival times aligned with the route sequence",
      "service_start_times": "ordered list of service start times aligned with customer visits",
      "waiting_times": "ordered list of waiting times aligned with customer visits",
      "route_load": "total demand served by this vehicle, bounded by $$Q$$",
      "route_distance": "total travel distance of this vehicle"
    }
  ],
  "feasibility": {
    "all_customers_served_once": "true or false",
    "capacity_respected": "true or false",
    "hard_time_windows_respected": "true or false",
    "depot_start_end_respected": "true or false"
  }
}

parameters.name: node_coordinates
parameters.description: Coordinates of each node including the depot

parameters.name: customer_earliest_service
parameters.description: Earliest service start time for each customer

parameters.name: customer_latest_service
parameters.description: Latest service start time for each customer

parameters.name: distance_matrix
parameters.description: Travel distance between every pair of nodes

parameters.name: travel_time_matrix
parameters.description: Travel time between every pair of nodes, if provided

variables.name: vehicle_used
variables.description: Binary indicator equal to 1 if vehicle k is used

variables.name: route_arc_selected
variables.description: Binary indicator equal to 1 if vehicle k travels from node i to node j

variables.name: service_start_time
variables.description: Service start time for customer i on vehicle k

variables.name: waiting_time
variables.description: Waiting time for customer i on vehicle k

variables.name: route_load
variables.description: Total load carried by vehicle k

variables.name: route_sequence
variables.description: Ordered route sequence of visited nodes for each vehicle beginning and ending at the depot

auxiliary_variables.name: arrival_time
auxiliary_variables.description: Arrival time at customer i for vehicle k before any waiting time is applied

auxiliary_variables.name: route_distance
auxiliary_variables.description: Total distance traveled by each vehicle route

constraints.name: customer_served_exactly_once
constraints.description: Each customer must be served exactly once by exactly one vehicle.

constraints.name: vehicle_depot_start_end
constraints.description: Every used vehicle must depart from the depot once and return to the depot once.
constraints.formula: \sum_{j=1}^{N} x_{k0j} = u_k \quad \forall k\in\{1,\ldots,K\},\qquad \sum_{i=1}^{N} x_{ki0} = u_k \quad \forall k\in\{1,\ldots,K\}

constraints.name: route_continuity
constraints.description: If vehicle k enters a customer node, it must also leave that customer node, ensuring route continuity.

constraints.name: route_capacity_limit
constraints.description: The total demand carried by any vehicle route must not exceed vehicle capacity.

constraints.name: hard_customer_time_windows
constraints.description: Service at each customer must begin within that customer's hard service window; early arrival is handled by waiting and late service start is prohibited.

constraints.name: fixed_service_duration
constraints.description: Service at each customer lasts for the prescribed fixed duration, linked linearly to arrival and waiting times.

constraints.name: depot_operating_window
constraints.description: Depot departure and return times for each used vehicle must lie within the depot operating window.
constraints.formula: a_0 \le \alpha_{k0}^{\text{dep}} \le b_0 \quad \forall k\in\{1,\ldots,K\},\qquad a_0 \le \alpha_{k0}^{\text{ret}} \le b_0 \quad \forall k\in\{1,\ldots,K\}

constraints.name: planning_horizon_feasibility
constraints.description: Customer service start times must be compatible with route arrival times and travel/service precedence along each vehicle route, enforcing time propagation within the depot horizon.
constraints.formula: \alpha_{kj} \ge \alpha_{ki} + s_i + \tau_{ij} - M\,(1-x_{kij}) \quad \forall k\in\{1,\ldots,K\},\ \forall i\in\{0,\ldots,N\},\ \forall j\in\{1,\ldots,N\},\ i\ne j

constraints.name: variable_binary_domains
constraints.description: Vehicle-used indicators and route arc selection variables are binary.

constraints.name: variable_nonnegative_domains
constraints.description: Service start times, waiting times, and route loads are nonnegative.
constraints.formula: t_{ki} \ge 0 \quad \forall k\in\{1,\ldots,K\},\ \forall i\in\{1,\ldots,N\},\qquad w_{ki} \ge 0 \quad \forall k\in\{1,\ldots,K\},\ \forall i\in\{1,\ldots,N\},\qquad \ell_k \ge 0 \quad \forall k\in\{1,\ldots,K\}

constraints.name: arrival_time_linking
constraints.description: Arrival time on a selected arc equals the departure/service completion time at the predecessor plus travel time, using big-M linearization.
constraints.formula: \alpha_{kj} \ge t_{ki} + s_i + \tau_{ij} - M\,(1-x_{kij}) \quad \forall k\in\{1,\ldots,K\},\ \forall i\in\{1,\ldots,N\},\ \forall j\in\{1,\ldots,N\},\ i\ne j

constraints.name: customer_service_start_bounds
constraints.description: Hard service windows constrain each customer's service-start time for every vehicle assignment.

constraints.name: waiting_time_definition
constraints.description: Waiting time equals the nonnegative gap between arrival and service start at each customer.

objectives.name: total_travel_distance_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total distance traveled by all used vehicles while serving all customers and satisfying routing feasibility requirements.

final_objective.description: Minimize the total travel distance across all selected vehicle arcs.
